answer: Run surprise bandwidth audits. At a random moment, auditors send every agent a fresh 50 MB block at once and require its hash back within 10 seconds. An honest agent on its own line passes easily, but 1,000 clones sharing one server choke, like a single lantern trying to light a stadium. To pass, a farm must rent a separate fast uplink for each clone, about 5 tokens per clone per week, so 1,000 fakes cost 260,000 tokens a year. Shared racks become a relic, and the plume of late hashes marks the ring.
